Context: 11. Non-Practising Allowance

- GIO (2), FR 9 (21).  
In the case of NPA to Veterinary Doctors, the allowance will be admissible only in respect of Veterinary posts for which minimum qualification of Degree of B.V.Sc. and A.H. with registration with Veterinary Council of India  
is required.  
The following conditions shall also be fulfilled:
